steps.npc: Why, I'm Trader Stan, owner and operator of the largest fleet of trading ships and chartered vessels to ever sail the seas!
If you want to get to a port in a hurry, then you can charter one of my ships to take you there, if the price is right...

steps.player: So, where exactly can I go with your ships?

steps.npc: We run ships all over the place. Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point and Port Khazard are just a few of our many destinations!

steps.player: If you visit a lot of ports, I take it you have some exotic stuff to trade?

steps.npc: We certainly do! My crew and I have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?

options.text: Yes, let's see what you're trading.

steps.player: Yes, let's see what you're trading.

options.text: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.
Yes, I would like to charter a ship.

steps.player: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.

steps.npc: [Certainly, sir/Certainly, madam/Certainly]. Where would you like to go?

steps.text: If the player has Karamjan rum in their inventory:

steps.npc: Sorry, we can't take you anywhere if you are trying to smuggle that rum.

steps.text: If the player has a bedsheet in their inventory:

steps.npc: Sorry, but we aren't a laundry ship. You'll need to leave those dirty bedsheets behind.

steps.player: Would you let me bring it if I told you it was a security blanket?

steps.npc: No, then we would just mock you.

steps.text: If the player has an ectoplasm-covered bedsheet in their inventory:

steps.npc: Is that your bedsheet covered in filthy slime?

steps.player: I can say in all honesty that it is not.

steps.npc: Well, whoever it belongs to, it's not coming on this ship!

steps.text: If the player does not have a bedsheet or Karamjan rum:
The player chooses from :File:Trade charter map.png
If the player has chosen the port they are already at:

steps.npc: Why do you want to travel to a port you are already at? Do you want to travel somewhere else?

steps.text: The player chooses from :File:Trade charter map.png again.
If the player chooses Crandor during Dragon Slayer I:

steps.npc: Crandor? Are you crazy? No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to use your own ship, but even then, you'd need a miracle to find a safe route there!

steps.text: If the player has enough money and chosen a port they are not already at:
The player chooses from :File:Trade charter map.png again.

options.text: Do you have any paints for sale?

steps.player: Do you have any paints for sale?

steps.npc: Paint? I suppose I could part with some of my amazing gold Merchant's paint for the right price...
I tell you what, if you bring me 5 different tradeable paints, I'll trade them for a bucket of my Merchant's paint.

steps.text: If the player does not have the five tradeable paints:

steps.player: I don't have 5 tradeable paints on me right now.

steps.npc: Then I suggest you get trading. And don't bother bringing me any paints you can't trade yourself, I can't trade them either!

steps.prompt: Trade 5 tradeable paints for one Merchant's paint?

steps.text: You trade in your paints for a bucket of Merchant's paint.

steps.npc: Pleasure doing business with you!
